values: 一名受到丰饶之力眷顾的战士，擅长使用长枪和圆盾进行战斗。
A Warrior blessed by the God of Harvest, skilled with spear and shield.
阻碍？哼。我会想办法解决。
An obstacle, hmph. I'll find a way around it!
这支长枪……能避免更多牺牲。
These hands, they've ended so many lives. But no...! I won't falter now.
这双杀敌无数的手……不，我不会犹豫。
With this spear... I can stop more needless deaths!
领主才配得上如此礼物，但，谢谢。
Only the Regulus deserves such a gift, but thank you.
人类和兽人终于和平相处……
Humans and Wildborn live peacefully here.
I can't slack off on training here.
珀尔修斯善于谋略，且十分看重士兵们的性命，擅长用最小的损失来获取胜利。
Perseus is a brilliant strategist who cares deeply about the safety of his soldiers. He excels at securing victory with minimal losses.
呼临士兵都很崇拜珀尔修斯，这让他有点头疼，他不希望每个与他交谈的人都兴奋过头。
Perseus finds the profound admiration from the Halian soldiers a bit overwhelming. He doesn't want them to get too excited when speaking to him.
身为呼临城统帅，珀尔修斯却崇尚和平，不希望轻易开战。为此有不少议事官质疑他的能力，但丰饶神赐下的长枪让他们不得不咽回这番话。

Although he is Halia's commander, Perseus values peace and sees war as a last resort. Many council members question his ability because of this, but the spear bestowed upon him by the God of Harvest always silences their criticisms.
珀尔修斯不介意士兵通过开玩笑活跃气氛，除了他的副将隆尔，因为隆尔的冷笑话总能把其他士兵吓得面色惨白。不过老实说，珀尔修斯觉得隆尔的笑话挺不错。

Perseus doesn't mind his men joking around to lighten the mood, except when it's Lieutenant Lygos' turn, as his deadpan humor always leaves the others pale with fear. Deep down, though, Perseus actually enjoys Lygos' jokes.
珀尔修斯只要有空，就会去看望阵亡士兵的家属。他始终都对牺牲的同胞心怀愧疚，只是从未和人提及。
Perseus often visits the families of fallen soldiers when he has the time. He feels indebted to those who perished on the battlefield, but he never speaks of these feelings to anyone.
珀尔修斯将阿邦德视作弟弟，既会为年少城主肩负重担而忧心，也为他的快速成长而颇感欣慰。
Perseus regards Abundius as his younger brother. While he worries about the heavy burdens on the young ruler, he also takes pride in witnessing his rapid growth.
刚入伍时，珀尔修斯喜欢拿盾牌当做飞盘和其他战友比赛。
Back in his early days of service, Perseus enjoyed tossing his shield around like a flying disc with his comrades.
在珀尔修斯得到丰饶神授予的长枪后，同僚们就再也不喊他来比拼力量了。他对此一直百思不得其解。
Since Perseus received the spear granted by the God of Harvest, his comrades have stopped challenging his strength. He has never figured out why.
据说珀尔修斯爱好雕刻，因为他的帐内总是放着几把凿子，还时不时地传来叮叮当当的声音。奇怪的是，谁也没见过他的作品。
Perseus is said to have a passion for sculpting. He always keeps a few chisels in his tent, with the sound of tapping echoing from time to time, but strangely, no one has ever seen his work.
珀尔修斯曾经想过，如果不参军，他会去当学者比博的助手，一起帮助更多呼临人。
Had Perseus not joined the military, he would have worked as an assistant to Bakis the scholar, helping those in need.
如今呼临食物紧缺，即便是我，也没有足够的食物招待你们。
Food's running low in Halia. Even I don't have enough to offer you a proper meal.
珀尔修斯 & 初代梅林
Your arms... Are they made out of vines?
人类和兽人终于和平相处……
Humans and Wildborn live peacefully here.
仇恨有时比信念更简单。
Sometimes, hating is easier than believing in something.
